messages.content: Great! I'm excited to get started on this project with you. To kick things off, can you tell me about the high-level goals you have for modernising the mobile banking app? What do you envision achieving with this update?

Yeah, so I really just want an app that feels more modern and quick, like Revolut. It’s frustrating to use my current banking app, and I want to know what's happening with my money instantly. I want to get notifications right away when something leaves my account. 

Also, if I lose my card, it would be great to just freeze it right in the app without having to call anyone. Just little things that make managing my money easier and faster.

That makes a lot of sense! It sounds like you’re looking for a more user-friendly experience that provides real-time information and control over your finances. 

To clarify, when you mention wanting "notifications right away," can you describe what specific types of notifications you’re thinking about? For example, are you looking for alerts on transactions, account balance changes, or something else?

Yeah, definitely. I want to know about every transaction as soon as it happens, like how much was spent, where it was spent, and what my balance is after that. Just something that keeps me in the loop so I don’t have to guess what's going on with my account. It’s just a lot more reassuring to see that stuff right away.

Got it! So, you want to receive instant notifications for every transaction, including details like the amount spent, the merchant, and your updated balance. That sounds like a valuable feature for keeping track of your finances.

Now, you also mentioned wanting to freeze your card directly in the app. Can you elaborate on how you envision that process? What steps would you like to take to freeze your card, and is there anything else you'd like to do in that scenario?

I just want it to be super simple. Like, if I realize I’ve lost my card, I just want to open the app, find the option to freeze it, and hit a button. It shouldn’t take more than a couple of taps. And then later, when I find it, I want to be able to unfreeze it just as easily. No calls or waiting around—just quick and easy control over my card.

That sounds very user-friendly! So, to summarize, you want the ability to freeze and unfreeze your card with just a couple of taps in the app, without needing to make calls or wait for assistance. This level of control is definitely a key feature for a modern banking experience.

Next, can we talk about budgeting tools? You mentioned wanting features that make managing money easier. What specific budgeting tools or features do you think would be most helpful for you in the app?

Yeah, budgeting tools would be really helpful. I think it would be great to set up a monthly budget for different spending categories—like groceries, dining out, or transport. And I’d want alerts if I’m getting close to my budget limit or if I go over it. Just something that helps me keep my spending in check without having to do a lot of math or tracking myself.

That’s a fantastic idea! So, you’re looking for a feature that allows you to set monthly budgets for different categories, along with alerts to notify you if you're approaching or exceeding those limits. This would definitely help with managing your spending without the hassle of manual tracking.

Now, let’s discuss integration with your existing core banking system. Are there any specific limitations or restrictions that you think we should consider when integrating these new features into the current system?

I haven’t really thought about that stuff. I just want the app to work well and have all the features I mentioned. As long as it’s easy to use and does what I need, I’m not too concerned about the technical side of things. I just hope it doesn’t complicate everything too much!

I understand! Your main focus is on having a user-friendly app that meets your needs without complicating things. It’s important that the new features integrate smoothly with the existing system while maintaining usability.

So far, we have the following requirements for the modernised mobile app:

1. Instant notifications for every transaction, including details like amount spent, merchant, and updated balance.
2. A simple option to freeze and unfreeze your card within the app with just a couple of taps.
3. Budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly budgets for different spending categories, with alerts for approaching or exceeding limits.
4. An overall focus on ease of use and a modern, user-friendly interface.

Now, to round out the requirements: Are there any other features or functionalities that come to mind that you think would enhance your experience with the banking app?

Hmm, let me think. It would be nice to see all my accounts in one place—like my current account, savings, and credit card balances—just so I can get the full picture at a glance. 

Also, maybe being able to send money to friends or to other accounts quickly would be handy. Just something that makes it easy to move money around without any hassle. But honestly, I’m mostly focused on the things we already talked about!

Great suggestions! To summarize, you’d like:

5. A dashboard that displays all accounts in one place (current account, savings, credit card balances) for a comprehensive overview.
6. The ability to send money quickly to friends or other accounts with ease.

With these points, we have gathered five clear requirements for the modernisation of the legacy banking app. Thank you for your input!
